decline.subject: Reminder: HHS CDC - Automated Labeler Support - MRAS
decline.rationale: Lab tube-labeling equipment O&M. Requirement is onsite installation, preventive maintenance, and repair of a Government-owned automated laboratory tube labeling system. No GIS, geospatial, or IT component. Matches neither capability_keywords_pass nor capability_keywords_maybe. Previously DECLINE on 2026-08-07. Second reminder for a closing-tomorrow opportunity.
